verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own framework integrations: a Google ADK extra captures every model call, tool call, and agent step with one line. The docs also claim every span from every framework is captured over OpenTelemetry and that LLM calls are captured at the SDK level. However, none of the frameworks named in the story (LangChain, OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK) appears explicitly, and docs-18 implies some SDKs have no integration and need manual `track_ai` wrapping. Missing for 10: explicit LangChain, OpenAI SDK and Vercel AI SDK integrations; an integration catalog; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: If you use **Google ADK**, install the extra so Bento can capture every call automatically
Capture every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app with one line.
Every span from every framework, captured over OpenTelemetry.
Bento captures every LLM call at the SDK level.
